title: Percentage Composition from Molecular Formula
notes: **Definition:** the mass percentage of each element in a compound, calculated from its molecular formula.
**Formula:** $\%\text{ of element} = \frac{n \times A_r}{M_r} \times 100$, where $n$ is the number of atoms, $A_r$ is relative atomic mass, and $M_r$ is relative molecular mass.
**Reverse calculation:** if percentage composition is known, assume 100 g of compound, convert percentages to masses, divide by atomic masses to get mole ratios, then find empirical formula.
**Molecular formula from empirical:** $n = M_r(actual)/M_r(empirical)$. Multiply empirical formula subscripts by $n$ to get the molecular formula.
